rationale: The single blocking finding from code-review-final.json (CR-001) was fixed in f2a86874b and verified by targeted test runs. No new findings. The one deferred finding remains deferred and is recorded below with its status re-assessed against the fix.

findings.fix_summary: isBudgetManagementEnabled is now part of previousBudgetFiltersRef — seeded at first render, compared in hasBudgetFiltersChanged, and written on every ref update. A false→true transition therefore counts as a change and fires exactly one corrective load carrying budget params. The fix removes the cross-file dependency on the App.tsx isConfigFetched gate that the earlier code comment relied on; that comment was replaced with one stating what the code now guarantees.
findings.verification: Regression suite src/pages/settings/administration/projectsManagement/__tests__/ProjectsManagementFull.initialLoad.test.tsx — 3 tests: (1) mount with the flag already true and a stored 'assigned' filter fires exactly 1 request; (2) a budget-filter change fires exactly 1 request; (3) an isBudgetManagementEnabled false→true transition after mount fires exactly 1 corrective refetch. RED/GREEN confirmed by reverting the production change: without the initial fix, test 1 fails with 'expected 1 times, but got 2 times'; with only the CR-001 change reverted, test 3 fails with 'expected 1 times, but got 0 times'.

deferred.title: Stale ref when budget filters change while budget management is disabled
deferred.note: Pre-existing: the effect still returns early without updating previousBudgetFiltersRef while isBudgetManagementEnabled is false, and this PR does not change that guard. The CR-001 fix does change the consequence the deferred item described — a load on flag enable is now the intended single corrective refetch rather than a spurious extra request.
